_base.title: Welcome to K3PTA — local and private
_base.content: No login, no cloud. Everything lives in ~/.kepta/kepta.db on this machine. Back it up through System → JSON export. MCP shares the very same store with Claude and Cursor.

_base.title: Shortcuts
_base.content: ⌘K opens the command list. ⌘N saves a new note. Search finds it again, and Graph draws how your notes hang together. The Context number decides how many notes travel with your question — fewer notes in, shorter answer back.
